summary: The current implementation satisfies the saved production configuration guardrails plan: local and CI defaults remain usable, AWF_ENV=prod rejects bundled local database credentials and missing or weak API tokens, callback-enabled production is guarded with the available API-token prerequisite, structured diagnostics avoid secret leakage, service resolution and FastAPI lifespan fail fast before admitting work, docs cover local-vs-production expectations, and the recorded validation evidence shows the requested pytest, ruff, and mypy commands passed.
